notes.title: February Update + Something Cool Coming Soon!
notes.content:
As we dive into the final steps of development, we’re super excited to share our progress for the month. Let’s take a look at what we achieved during February!

Our entire voice cast has finished recording, and we’ve edited and implemented their performances into the game. We need to finalize a handful of line retakes, but this should be wrapped up quickly! It’s such a thrill playing through the game now that it is voiced!
Our PC build for the game is shaping up well. We spent the month trying to improve performance and squash a couple of lingering bugs. If all goes well, we’ll be able to spend some time next month focusing on developing Steam-specific features, such as achievements and cloud saves.
Our Nintendo Switch build is coming along nicely! There’s a lot more to consider when developing for this platform. The hardware is a little more restrictive than PC, so we’ve spent a lot of time optimizing game assets (graphics, music, voice) to ensure the game performs well on this console. We’re still working on ironing out a few things - there are a couple of inconsistencies with Joy-Con controls that we’re trying to smooth out right now.
In other news:

We’re working with a very talented (and very famous) singer to produce a brand new song in collaboration with our composer, Alec Shea. This is a BIG deal, and I think you’re all going to love it. You’re in for a real treat when we drop the final track soon… For now, we need to remain tight-lipped, but keep an eye (or an ear) on our social pages in the coming weeks.

Twitter (https://twitter.com/rivercrowstudio)

Youtube (https://www.youtube.com/rivercrowstudio)

Steam (https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/rivercrow)

We’ll wrap things up here for now. Looking forward to sharing more with you soon!

notes.title: CORPSE FACTORY Development Log - October
notes.content:
Welcome to the fourth development log for CORPSE FACTORY. What do we have in store for you today…?

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1414250/CORPSE_FACTORY/][i][b]Be sure to wishlist CORPSE FACTORY on Steam![/b][/i][/url]

[h2]PART ONE - How is development progressing?[/h2]

Development continues to proceed smoothly. No major road bumps or incidents this month! The areas outlined in bold below have seen an improvement since last month.

Character Art - 100% complete
Event/CG Art - 100% complete
Original Soundtrack - 100% complete
Script - 95% complete
[b]Background Art - 100% complete (Finished!)
Programming - 75% complete
Visual Effects - 70% complete
Audio Effects - 70% complete
Mystery! - 10% complete[/b]

I’m sure you’ve been curious about the little mystery section we included in last month’s update. This is a major announcement that we hope to reveal within the next few weeks. All the pieces are in place, and we’re just waiting on a few tiny little things to be set into motion before we make the official announcement.

Want a clue?

Maybe we’re making one of the Kickstarter stretch goals happen… even though we didn’t quite meet the funding.

You’ll just have to wait and see!

Our background artist has finished the final background for the game. Due to spoilers, we can’t show it off  in this update, but now the artist can take a well-earned break while we work on the rest of the game.

[h2]PART TWO - Character profile: Tomoe Watanabe[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40405389/811b89f783616182c5bcce27910584464ce100f4.png[/img]

Tomoe’s a fighter, through and through. She’s strong, opinionated, unapologetic and has a foul mouth. She’s a Japanese ‘gyaru’ (gal) girl - armed with a fake tan, bleached blonde hair, long nails and over-the-top clothes.

Thanks to her overbearing personality and stand-out look, Tomoe doesn’t really fit in anywhere. She definitely doesn’t seem to fit the standard look of an office worker, yet she’s a corporate employee just like Noriko.

Something about Noriko rubs her the wrong way. Tomoe can’t help but instigate conflict whenever they bump into each other in the office. This has created an overwhelming level of tension between the two.

As is usually the case, there’s more to Tomoe than meets the eye. Why does she hate Noriko so much? Why is she so quick to jump to violence?

Perhaps you’ll dig a bit into Tomoe’s life during the course of the game. And maybe - just maybe - you’ll find that she’s not actually as bad as she seems on the surface...

[h2]PART THREE - Screenshot showcase[/h2]

Feast your eyes on a selection of new screenshots of the game in action!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40405389/45a99c91d8a69c7b0bcedd062d903c01d1f82f6e.png[/img]

That’s all for this month’s development log! Be sure to stay tuned for our next update at the end of November.

notes.title: CORPSE FACTORY Development Log - September
notes.content:
The third development log for CORPSE FACTORY is here! Read on to learn about the progress we made during September.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1414250/CORPSE_FACTORY/][i][b]Be sure to wishlist CORPSE FACTORY on Steam![/b][/i][/url]

[h2]PART ONE - How is development progressing?[/h2]

Development is speeding along at a rapid pace. The areas outlined in bold below have seen an improvement since last month.

Character Art - 100% complete
Event/CG Art - 100% complete
Original Soundtrack - 100% complete
Script - 95% complete
[b]Background Art - 98% complete (Just one background left to go!)
Programming - 70% complete
Visual Effects - 60% complete
Audio Effects - 60% complete
Mystery...! - ??% complete 
[i][We've been working on something top-secret this month... Can't wait to share it with you soon!][/i][/b]

With only one background illustration left to complete, we're about ready to finish that important part of the project.

In addition, the second character route is nearly complete. If you'd like a hint as to who you'll be accompanying during the second section of the game, check out the screenshots down below...

[h2]PART TWO - Character profile: Aoi Satou[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40405389/0456c38910eeca4a4b07a751457deddd3c76efc6.png[/img]

What can we say about Aoi without giving you the wrong impression...?

She's shy. Painfully so. She's conversationally awkward, even more than Kojiro.

She leans on her best friend, Noriko, a little too much. Her reliance tends to strain the friendship, which makes things even more awkward for her.

She's innocent at heart, but those who know her get the impression she's been through a lot of awful things in the past. Only Noriko truly knows the cause of the pain behind Aoi's smile.

Though she's tied up in Noriko's life thanks to their years of friendship, there's another reason that she soon gets involved in Corpse Girl's awful business...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40405389/45a8d4fabcb8c5d731fc21c6fa63be770c247e1e.png[/img]

[h2]PART THREE - Background showcase[/h2]

Here is a selection of backgrounds completed this month. Many of these backgrounds feature variants that display different times of day - early morning, evening, late night, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40405389/cdfb01b499e9329ba091465ec394f4a13431e6b4.png[/img]

That’s all for this month’s development log! Be sure to stay tuned for our next update at the end of October.
